summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing for Nexora AI landing page. All 11 backend pytest cases passed (root, leads CRUD, validation, sort/no _id leak). Frontend: all 10 sections render, 5 nav anchors work, Hero CTAs scroll to #cta, lead form submits successfully with success toast and clears fields, empty submit shows validation error toast, mobile layout renders correctly at 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: `logger` is referenced on line 97 (inside create_lead) but defined on line 127 (after app.include_router). It works because the logger is resolved at call time, not module-load time, but conventionally `logging.basicConfig` + `logger = ...` should be placed before any handler that uses it for readability and safety.
backend/server.py: `POST /api/status` inserts the StatusCheck but the response model returns the original object (OK) — no _id leak. Good.

CTASection.jsx: HTML5 `required` on inputs combined with `type=submit` means browser-level validation fires before the custom toast for the audit button — fine, but `submit-call` and `submit-demo` are `type=button` and rely on JS validation, which works correctly.
No rate limiting on POST /api/leads — public lead endpoint is susceptible to spam/abuse. Recommend adding basic rate limit or captcha before production.
seed_data_creation: Test leads with TEST_ prefix inserted during pytest (name starts with TEST_, emails test_*@example.com). Safe to ignore or clean later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_leads_api.py cover root + leads endpoints. Frontend landing uses data-testid: hero-section, positioning-section, problem-section, services-section, products-section, how-section, benefits-section, case-study-section, cta-section, site-footer (NOT footer-section). Nav: nav-link-{company,services,products,process,work}. Form: audit-form, form-name/email/company/message, submit-audit/call/demo. Hero CTAs: hero-cta-audit, hero-cta-call. Toast library is sonner.
